stem: In an A/B test on basket value, a few business buyers spend €20,000 or more. The analyst has checked that these orders are real, and wants a summary that keeps every customer in the count but stops a few huge baskets from deciding the result. Which summary fits?

options.text: The plain mean of all baskets
A mean that leaves out every business buyer's basket
A winsorised mean, with a cap set before the test
A trimmed mean that drops the top and bottom 5%
